digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / completion verifier / attestation validation
propositions: [operator-attested] tag on code-verifiable acceptance criteria with repository path/symbol evidence bypasses plan-review guards and reaches the completion verifier, which trusts the tag at face value per ADR-0043 design
Evidence-kind criterion runs but misses nondeterministically that a tagged AC cites exact repo paths, failing to block the laundering anti-pattern before close
det_measurement_provenance detects missing provenance: continuation lines but wires them as advisory (P6 / p6_ac_quality) so they do not block despite being required for tagged ACs
A deterministic pre-close guard must reject tagged ACs whose own text cites repo path/symbol evidence or whose provenance line is absent, firing before any LLM judgment

Mixed criteria (repo-verifiable + external evidence combined) must SPLIT: repo citations move to untagged criterion, external outcome keeps tag with provenance line, to prevent false rejection of legitimate multi-faceted ACs
